title: 12 Best Sushi in Tokyo
description: Discover the 12 best sushi restaurants in Tokyo for 2026. From Michelin-starred omakase to bustling market stalls, find your perfect sushi experience in Japan's culinary capital.

places.name: Sukiyabashi Jiro Honten
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Omakase tasting menu is the only option, perfectly curated by Jiro or his son.

places.name: Sushi Saito
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The seasonal Omakase menu, featuring impeccably sourced fish and perfectly seasoned rice.

places.name: Kyubey Ginza Honten
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Omakase course (Chef's Choice) at the counter, which often includes their signature uni and fatty tuna.

places.name: Sushi Sawada
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The comprehensive Omakase menu, trusting the chef's daily selections.

places.name: Sushi Sho Masa
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The full Omakase experience; allow the chef to surprise you with his innovative pairings and preparations.

places.name: Sushi Dai
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Omakase set (Chef's Choice) offers the best value and variety, often including a piece of your choice at the end.

places.name: Daiwa Sushi
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Omakase set, which typically includes 7 pieces of nigiri, a roll, and miso soup.

places.name: Sushi no Midori (Shibuya Mark City)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Cho-Tokusen Nigiri' (Super Special Assortment) for a wide range of fresh, expertly prepared pieces, or the melt-in-your-mouth anago (sea eel).

places.name: Uobei Shibuya Dogenzaka
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Order several plates of your favorites, like salmon, tuna, or inventive rolls. Don't miss their tempura.

places.name: Sushi Zanmai Honten
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their Maguro Zanmai set to sample various cuts of tuna, from lean akami to super fatty otoro.

places.name: Ganko Sushi Shinjuku
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their various nigiri sets or kaisendon (seafood rice bowls) for lunch, which offer excellent value.

places.name: Sushi Ginza Onodera Honten
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Omakase course, featuring their perfectly aged tuna and seasonal delicacies.
